user.title: Sign in to Nectr
user.description: Use the email and password you use for Nectr My Account. Nectr will email you a 6-digit code to finish signing in. Your password is not stored.

otp.title: Enter your Nectr code
otp.description: Nectr has emailed a 6-digit code to {email}. Codes can take a while to arrive. {status}

data.resend: Send me a new code instead

data_description.resend: Tick this and submit to have Nectr email a new code.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in to Nectr again
reauth_confirm.description: Home Assistant is no longer signed in to Nectr as {email}. Enter your password and Nectr will email you a new code.

error.too_many_attempts: Too many sign-in attempts. Wait a while and try again.
error.invalid_otp: That code is not right. Check it and try again.
error.otp_expired: That code has expired. Tick "Send me a new code" to get another.
error.too_many_otp_attempts: Too many incorrect codes. Tick "Send me a new code" to get another.
error.login_expired: This sign-in has expired. Close this dialog and start again.

abort.no_accounts: No active Nectr accounts were found for this login.
abort.not_smart_meter: This Nectr account does not have a smart meter, so Nectr has no hourly usage to import.
abort.wrong_account: This login does not have access to the Nectr account this entry was set up with.

data_description.history_poll_interval: Minutes between updates while past usage is still being imported, a month at a time from the newest back. Once the history is complete, Nectr is checked every three hours.

auth_failed.message: Nectr rejected the saved sign-in. Sign in again to continue.

update_failed.message: Could not get data from Nectr: {error}

entry_not_found.message: No Nectr account with config entry ID {entry_id}.

invalid_date_range.message: The start date must not be after the end date.

reimport.name: Re-import usage
reimport.description: Fetches a range of days from Nectr again and rewrites their statistics, picking up corrections and filling gaps. Later statistics are shifted so the running totals stay continuous.

end_date.name: End date
end_date.description: Last day to re-import. Defaults to today.
